title: Moreau-Yosida Penalization of McKean-Vlasov Dynamics: Full-Flux Limits and Boundary Reaction Measures
summary: We study McKean-Vlasov Fokker-Planck dynamics on a compact convex set $K\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ through the whole-space Moreau-Yosida penalization $U_λ=\operatorname{dist}(\cdot,K)^2/(2λ)$, keeping the external and interaction potentials fixed. At finite times, the penalized densities converge to the unique variational solution of the reflected no-flux equation, strongly in space-time $L^2$ on $K$ and in whole-space $L^1$, and narrowly, uniformly in time.
